messages:
anya (Marketing): quick loop for the "RefApp Starter" OSS launch + webinar. need decisions: announcement angle, short benchmark narrative, signup routing, and who owns tutorials.
leo (DevRel): can we emphasize "starter templates" + one-click deploy in GH? that helps adoption.
rachel (Product): yes, highlight low-friction path: Open repo -> run demo -> integrate SDK. also call out expected perf (hosted) and an enterprise note.
mike (Eng): i'll prepare a tiny benchmark script that shows latency and cost per 1k tokens. will keep it runnable in CI.
anya (Marketing): timeline: draft post by Mon, tutorial notebook + README by Wed, webinar next Tue. ops-bot can route signups?
ops-bot: ROUTE PROPOSAL:
- company_size >= 50 -> sales-enterprise
- SDK beta checked -> devrel-signal
- else -> growth-inbound
Confirm to apply? :robot_face:
leo (DevRel): add a devrel field for preferred language (python/js) to help triage.
rachel (Product): messaging variants: A) "Kickstart your LLM feature with a ready-made refapp" B) "Ship faster: reference app, benchmarks, and SDKs" — test both in subject.
anya (Marketing): good. leo, can you draft a 3-bullet benchmark sidebar (p50/p95, tokens/sec, hosting cost per 1k)? keep it consumer-friendly.
leo (DevRel): yep. chart idea: small bar chart of tokens/sec across variants + a tiny table.
mike (Eng): sample run output for README:
$ ./run_bench --model redwood-mini --tokens 1024
latency p50: 62ms
cost per 1k: $0.04
cache hit: true
anya (Marketing): owners: marketing=anya, devrel=leo, product=rachel, eng=mike. i'll draft the post and share PR link. ping here for edits. :rocket:
